content.text:
I couldn't save the migration file. A team-workflow plugin hook blocks writes to anything under `migrations/` until a person has reviewed it, so I didn't try to get around it. Nothing has been run.

Please create **`migrations/0001_add_users_last_login_at.sql`** with this content. It's numbered 0001 because the directory doesn't exist yet, so this is the first migration.

```sql
-- 0001_add_users_last_login_at
-- Adds a nullable last_login_at timestamp to users. Existing rows get NULL (never logged in / unknown).

ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL;

-- Rollback:
-- ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN last_login_at;
```

The `users` table in `src/db.js` currently has `id`, `email`, `name` and `deleted_at`. I made the new column nullable so the existing rows (Ada, Grace and Alan) stay valid without needing a value. `src/db.js` is only an in-memory stand-in, so if you want the seed data to show the new field, you'd also need to add `last_login_at: null` to each user there.
